topic: How do MPLS and IPsec VPNs differ in mitigating congestion for real-time QoS in multi-telectric utility backbones?
consensus_response: MPLS and IPsec VPNs differ in congestion mitigation through traffic prioritization and routing. MPLS uses label switching to prioritize traffic, while IPsec relies on encryption and tunneling, introducing latency. MPLS dynamically adjusts routes to avoid congestion, ensuring real-time QoS.
reference_context: QoS provisioning relies on managing capacity, with MPLS and IPsec having different strengths in prioritizing traffic and mitigating congestion.
